A whitespace-only span opening a div does not indent the image after it into a code block

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>P</p>\n<div>\n<span>    </span><img alt=\"A\" src=\"S\"/>\n</div>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content as Any)
```
